name: CASCADE HEATING SPECIALTIES
address: 1507 NE FIRST ST STE A, BEND, OR 97701

fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Post the address visibly at the detached structure so responders can quickly identify it as a separate building on the property.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation growing close to either structure so responders can walk the perimeter without pushing through plant growth.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked or clearly marked so responders arriving from the rear can identify and use it quickly.
• Mark any gate or barrier controlling rear access so it is visible at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Keep both vehicle parking areas clear of stored items so responding units have room to stage or reposition.
• Keep the walkway between structures free of equipment, furniture, or plant growth that could slow movement during an emergency.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest to any structures to create open space between the trees and the buildings.
• Remove low-hanging branches from scattered trees close to structures so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Keep the ground beneath tree clusters clear of dead leaves, fallen branches, and dry grass.
• Separate scattered trees from each other where they grow close together near structures to reduce the chance fire moves between them.
• Keep open terrain areas free of dry grass and accumulated dead plant material, especially where open ground connects directly to structures.
• Trim any grass or low vegetation growing beneath scattered trees to reduce the amount of burnable material at ground level.
